item.title: Tesla says it will start selling Cybercabs by end of year
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Tesla said Wednesday it will start selling its Cybercab to customers by the end of the year, even as federal regulators investigate whether the vehicle meets vehicle safety standards. The gold-hued, autonomous two-seater lacks a steering wheel and other traditional controls. During the company’s third-quarter earnings call, Lars Moravy, vice president of engineering at Tesla, […]

item.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

item.title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The social media giant is planning a new stock strategy to help power its broad investments in AI models and services.

item.title: Airbnb limits chores for guests, sparking backlash from hosts
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Hosts are threatening to leave the platform after Airbnb says that they can no longer require guests to strip beds or do other time-consuming cleaning chores.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

item.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.

item.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Just 9 months after raising a $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed a $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."

item.title: Tesla starts Optimus robot production in California as profit falls 43%
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane
item.description: Tesla's revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed as it pressed the accelerator on its Optimus robots, AI, and autonomous driving.

item.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

item.title: Automattic begins layoffs following board upheaval and executive departures
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Sources say more cuts could follow as the company looks to improve its finances.

item.title: GM is betting compute and AI will help it compete with Chinese automakers
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant, Kirsten Korosec
item.description: To compete with Tesla, Rivian, and a host of Chinese automakers, GM’s fourth-gen EV platform will roll out a new central computer and electrical architecture that will debut in 2028 in the Cadillac Escalade IQ.

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $25B in case related to Cambridge Analytica scandal
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The payout is related to a recent trial involving the social media giant that revolved around its data privacy practices.

item.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

item.title: The internet is having a very bad cybersecurity day
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: From AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities to flaws in Node.js and popular AI tool LiteLLM, cybersecurity teams have plenty to worry about this week.

item.title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.

item.title: GM is giving OnStar an AI makeover
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: It's one of the biggest overhauls ever to the 30-year-old connected car product.

item.title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

item.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

item.title: Waymo starts offering rides at the Las Vegas airport
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Waymo only just started offering rides to the public in Las Vegas in September but is already serving a 24-square-mile area in the city.

item.title: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company’s acquisition
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.
